programme.title: Great Destinations Americas
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1545, Pope Paul III took Parma and Piacenza away from the papal territories to create a new duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese and free them from the influence of the Lombard Gonzaga family. The first duke and his heirs Alessandro and Ranuccio welcomed some Correggio's to work in the baptistery of the cathedral and some Parmigianino's paintings in the monastery of San Paolo.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale, Jeff reflects on his favorite moments shared with chef Mirciny Moliviatis—from vibrant markets to intimate kitchen conversations. Together, they share a heartfelt meal, revisit the colorful streets of Guatemala, and experience life on a small coffee farm near Lake Atitlán, where tradition and sustainability go hand in hand. It's a warm, personal close to a season filled with rich flavors, meaningful encounters, and unforgettable landscapes.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: The historic center of Naples is the largest in Europe. This Italian city has a spectacular townscape settings with sea & hillside. The place consist of narrow streets, ancient churches, unique underground landscapes & was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1995.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Nazca is a city and system of valleys on the southern coast of Peru. The name is heavily influenced by archaeological culture called as Nazca culture This culture is famous for its desert line drawings which are usually spotted from an aircraft. If someone visits Peru , then Nazca city is worth a visit

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Quebec is the only city in North America to retain it's collonial reference. In mid 80's UNESCO included this city in World Heritage Site. Walking through culture landmarks, churches , old stone fortifications , picnic parks are some of the to do things there. This place is truly to must visit when anyone visits Canada.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: London , Europe largest city is also one of the world's cultural capital. Besides tubes , streets & enjoying the vibe of the city , one of the place people should visit is Palace of Westminster. The building is a meeting place for both the House of Commons and the House of Lords & also informally known as Houses of Parliament. This palace is one of the centers of political life in the United Kingdom & anyone who goes to London should check out this place.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Paris, the city of Lights, the fashion capital, the city of Love. All these nicknames are far from enough to reveal all of Paris. Paris is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. It is known worldwide for the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame cathedral, and the Eiffel tower.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Berlin, the capital city of Germany, is renowned for its exceptional range of landmarks, vibrant cultural scene and way of life that's somehow all go yet relaxed. In fact, the city is best known for its striking contrasts. Historical buildings stand alongside modern architecture as the past and present intermingle.
